posts.headline: How a business account is set up
posts.caption:
When we set up a business account, the first question we ask is how your finance team wants the invoice to look.

Some want one invoice a month. Some want a PO or cost-centre reference on every journey line. Some would rather pay by card at booking and move on.

Central Executive Transfers Ltd is VAT registered and issues VAT invoices. Accounts get monthly invoicing, a PO or cost-centre reference on each journey's invoice line, and 30-day terms. Or the client pays by card at booking.

Our chauffeurs are professional, licensed and enhanced-DBS checked, and the phone is answered 24/7.

If you book travel for a team in South Yorkshire and would like to see how an account would work, send me a message. Link in the first comment.

posts.headline: Five questions to ask any chauffeur firm
posts.caption:
Before you open an account with any chauffeur firm, five questions are worth asking.

1. Is the operator licensed? Ours is: Operator Licence OP037, Sheffield City Council.
2. Are the drivers DBS checked? Every one of our chauffeurs is council-licensed and enhanced-DBS checked.
3. Can you issue VAT invoices? Central Executive Transfers Ltd is VAT registered, with a PO or cost-centre reference on each journey line.
4. Is the phone answered 24/7? Ours is, by phone and WhatsApp.
5. Can you show your insurance? Certificates are available on request.

Save it for your next supplier review. Link in the first comment.
